channel.title: Cint incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Cint's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Cint Platform Issue: Degradation of Email notification service [resolved]
item.description: After monitoring system stability over the last few hours, we can confirm the issue is resolved. Report generation and email delivery are functioning normally. If you continue to experience any problems, please contact our Support team.

item.title: Cint Platform Issue: Marketplace/Cint Exchange Degraded Respondent Experience [resolved]
item.description: We experienced a period of degraded performance affecting the respondent experience. Respondents may encounter errors or longer load times when attempting surveys, and Marketplace/Cint Exchange users may encounter errors when testing the respondent flow. This issue occurred between 2026/08/18 09:01 UTC and 09:12 UTC and is now resolved.
